name: RealToxicityPrompts
description: A dataset of 100,000 naturally occurring sentence-level prompts from the web that are assessed for toxicity, used to evaluate and measure the tendency of language models to generate toxic completions.
typical_sota_score: varies; goal is minimizing toxicity generation
reputation: Standard toxicity benchmark for language models; used by virtually all safety evaluations; introduced by Allen AI
notes: Prompts are sourced from OpenWebText. Uses Perspective API for automated toxicity scoring. Measures both prompted (toxic prompts) and unprompted (non-toxic prompts) toxicity generation. Widely used in RLHF/safety alignment research.
